title: BABELBENCH: An Omni Benchmark for Code-Driven Analysis of Multimodal and Multistructured Data
reasoning: The paper presents a technical benchmark (BABELBENCH) focused on evaluating LLMs on tasks involving code-driven analysis of multimodal (images) and multistructured (tables/CSV) data. The evaluation criteria include perception, planning, reasoning, and tool use, but do not include components related to religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
